title: Mazurka musicality - Balfolk tutorial with Michael Parmenter

Explanation of mazurka origins and triple time rhythm.
Breaking down mazurka rhythm and contrasting with walking steps.
Practicing alternation of mazurka rhythm and walking steps.
Reviewing combinations and discussing improvisation and variations.
